In the modern days, the mighty magicians of the Magnusons have to control their once glorious elite warriors. With the pass of centuries they've turned into mad-boys obsessed in scarabs, well they also lost their bodies but that's not important... They have to be controlled to stay focused on the battlefield and fight with their brothers until all the dust has gone.

This kit includes several pieces to convert your modern dusty scarab armored warriors and give them their glorious old days flavour.

Parts included (everything tartarus compatible):

- 5 torsos with heads
- 3 tabards from different cabals
- kopeshi combat weapons: axe and stave for band leader
- infernal shooting combi-weapon
- decorating bits for band leader: cape, stoles, spell book and enchantment scrolls
- shoulders in 2 designs and with 3 cabal symbols
- special shoulder for the band leader with 3 cabal symbols
- infernal missile rack adapter
- rotatory barrel to convert the warping flamer into a reaping cannon

As all my files, all the parts are presupported.

> Thanks to:

> - Rethonn for the cape
> - Graygawr for the loincloth
> - Garin for the back piece
> - Sakhrynandrii for the book
> - Ultraviolence for the scrolls

As all my files, all the parts are presupported.

This Hammerhead archer has you in his sights!


[Click here for Bullshark Warrior!](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4411931)


[Click here for the Greenland Mage!](https://www.thingiverse.com/thing:4411970)

This is 28mm scale miniature is ideal for tabletop role playing games such as D&D or Pathfinder. It is scaled to be printed as a -Large- miniature, which would fit on a 50.8mm diameter base. These sharks are big! If you attempt to print these as a medium sized creature, scale down to 50% (And take a picture, I'd love to see it!)

Feel free to glue a bit of string or fishing line or thin styrene in as a bow string :D

Included is a pre-supported Chitubox file that includes the Bullshark and Hammerhead for resin printing that has been tested and adjusted. Test printing was done on an Elegoo Mars in Elegoo Standard Gray at 7.7s / layer. I suggest running it through the Photon File Validator before printing!

[If you liked this model and want to show your thanks, you can buy me a coffee!](https://ko-fi.com/clayrade)

[And follow me on Instagram!](https://www.instagram.com/clay.rade/)
